name: Congregation
overview: The Scriptures reveal that the congregation of the LORD is a sacred assembly from which certain individuals are excluded, such as those physically mutilated, bastards, and specific nations like the Ammonites and Moabites, who are barred even to the tenth generation (Deuteronomy 23:1-3). Within this congregation, believers gather to praise God openly and declare His name among brethren, emphasizing worship in His sanctuary and the power of communal praise (Psalms 22:22; 150:1). The congregation also anticipates the coming day of the LORD, a time of divine judgment and blessing that will unfold among His people (Zechariah 14:1).
